pages.title: Enemy Wakizashi
pages.text: Wakizashi-type monsters are larger in size and easier to hit. They have relatively fast attack speed and high damage, with a spawn frequency lower than that of tantou-type monsters among all Retrograde Army monsters.

pages.name: Enemy Wakizashi
pages.text: The basic wakizashi unit of the Retrograde Army. Relatively agile in size, with fast attack speed.

pages.name: Enemy Specialized Wakizashi
pages.text: A specialized enemy wakizashi with further increased attack power and movement speed, posing a significantly greater threat.

pages.name: Enemy Kiwame Wakizashi
pages.text: The Kiwame form of enemy wakizashi, possessing even higher attack speed and damage. The ultimate threat among wakizashi-type monsters.
